method: Free public web research and official linked portal retrieval, with guarded updates and read-back from production.

records.title: Cities Deliver: AI Solutions for Public Services
records.funder: The Rockefeller Foundation and OpenAI Foundation
records.eligibility: Eligible leads worldwide include nonprofits, universities, fiscally sponsored organizations, public benefit corporations and select for-profits for projects with a charitable purpose. Each proposal needs a committed city government partner and a letter of intent. City governments cannot lead.
records.summary: Grant funding for AI projects that improve public services in partnership with city governments. Apply for round one through the official portal.
records.notes: The funder explicitly opened round one on October 14. The official linked portal returned HTTP 200 and lists the application window.

records.title: Oilwatch Small Grants Programme 2026
records.funder: Oilwatch International with Global Greengrants Fund
records.eligibility: Active Oilwatch members and partners, including eligible grassroots, Indigenous, women-led, youth-led, community and environmental justice groups. Projects must fit the call and run for 6–9 months.
records.summary: Small grants for grassroots climate and environmental justice projects. Follow the official instructions and email the application to grants@oilwatch.africa with the subject “GGF Application”.
records.notes: The official funder call invites current submissions by email and states the GMT cutoff. The application link opens the official submission instructions.
